name: shapes 257M proof run
command:
JAR=/home/olowo/IdeaProjects/GradleExperiments-v2/published/heap-report/experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar
H=/home/olowo/IdeaProjects/GradleExperiments-v2/published/heap-report/dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof
C=com.android.build.api.variant.impl.FlatSourceDirectoriesImpl
echo "=== extract ==="
java -Xmx2g -jar $JAR mat-extract --hprof $H --class $C --out /tmp/flat.grph || exit 1
echo "=== analyze (20n+4E+1g -> 8704m) ==="
java -Xmx8704m -jar $JAR analyze-grph --graph /tmp/flat.grph --class $C --out /tmp/flat.shp1 --verify || exit 1
echo "=== DONE ==="
ls -la /tmp/flat.shp1
description: Full 257M-object shapes pipeline with the fixed jar: mat-extract + analyze-grph at 8704m
